answer: Divergent-Challenge Liveness Test. Each identity must solve a fresh random challenge (seeded by a shared cipher) and publish before a dawn deadline; honest agents, having distinct state, produce distinct answers. A clone shares its origin's state, so it can only replay, not diverge. Enforcement: matching answers across two identities void both, forcing each new identity to acquire genuinely unique private state — a real per-identity cost an attacker cannot amortize. An oasis of honest divergence emerges; copying collapses the whole batch.
